current_evidence: The PDF text says 'Revised October 2024'. Searches of broxtowe.gov.uk found no newer local list. The validation-requirements page mentions only a 14 Feb 2024 BNG update, and its checklist links did not render on fetch, so currency is moderately confident.

issues.detail: The date value is right but the basis is wrong. Grokbot used PDF metadata CreationDate, while the document text says 'Revised October 2024'. The validation page separately says the notes were updated 14 Feb 2024 for BNG.

Local requirements in the source that are not captured: Building for a Healthy Life assessment (major development); Coal Mining Risk Assessment (site in a Development High Risk Area); Energy Efficiency/Sustainability Statement; Electric Vehicle Charging Points (major housing; commercial >=1,000 sqm); Landscape Assessment (within or affecting a local landscape character area, Policy 30); Noise Impact Assessment (disturbance issues or noise-sensitive development); Open Space Assessment (development within public open space); Statement of Community Involvement (major applications); Transport Assessment (all major, and proposals with significant transport implications); Telecommunications supplementary information (mast/antenna applications). The Structural Survey (e.g. barn conversions) also appears only under Listed building consent.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist 02 requirement table rows for each of these items.

issues.detail: Three items are wrongly placed under Householder because the word 'Householder' appeared in a table header near them. Affordable Housing Statement applies to residential schemes of more than 10 dwellings. Drainage Strategy applies to all major applications. Travel Plan applies where significant movement is generated. Outline and Reserved matters show '(none)', although the major/minor columns of the list apply to them.
issues.evidence: Affordable Housing Statement: 'residential schemes of more than 10 dwellings'; Drainage Strategy: 'all major applications'.

issues.detail: Most items are labelled 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' without the major/minor distinction that the source's Householder/Minor/Major columns give. Examples: Air Quality, Health Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings / >5,000 m2), Draft Heads of Terms and Drainage Strategy are major-only; Tree Survey also applies to Householder.
issues.evidence: Table columns 'Householder Major Minor' with ticks per requirement.

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are garbled, cut off or belong to other rows. Affordable Housing Statement's excerpt is the table header and plans text. Drainage Strategy's excerpt is the heritage asset trigger plus the Heads of Terms text. Travel Plan's runs into the Tree survey row. Design and Access Statement ends mid-sentence ('works that are'). Fire Statement is cut off ('within the curtilage of'). Landscaping scheme is just 'for example, landscaping plans.' Parking is a fragment. Retail impact is 'other main town centre uses located within the town centre.' and loses the 2,500 m2 out-of-centre threshold.
issues.evidence: Source: retail/leisure/office impact assessment required outside town centres 'over 2,500 m2'.

issues.detail: The Air Quality Assessment excerpt gives generic AQMA wording and omits the local trigger: most developments near Iona Drive/Tiree Close, Trowell, in addition to all major applications.
issues.evidence: Air quality row: all major; developments near Iona Drive / Tiree Close, Trowell.

issues.detail: The tab_items 'Submission rules' entries are fragments, not local requirements. One is the national BNG statement, cut off at 'in the form of both an Exc'. The other is an NPPF paras 54-57 reference with a broken URL and 'Examples of areas where obligations may be sought:'.

Drainage Strategy appears under both Householder and Full planning with the same garbled excerpt. Highways/access details and Parking provision both draw on the same 'existing and proposed vehicle parking provision and access arrangements' text.
Block plan, sections and elevations are drawing-standard guidance largely mirroring national requirements, and are listed as local Full-planning requirements.
issues.evidence: 'Site, layout or block plans at a recognised scale preferably one of 1:200 or 1:500'.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Broxtowe list (Revised October 2024). The extraction misses about 10 local requirements (e.g. EV charging, Coal Mining Risk Assessment, SCI, Transport Assessment), puts major-only items under Householder, and has many garbled triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
